solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: The French held in disdain by English survey

indicators.note: something held in another is enclosed by it, so one word sits inside the other here

parts.note: contempt is scorn or disdain
la is the French feminine form of 'the'

explanation.surface: A haughty English survey that sneers at the French.
explanation.definitionFit: To survey something is to look at it at length, to view and consider it carefully.

clue.text: Popeye's companion Bluto's ultimate experience

indicators.note: ultimate means final, so only the closing letter of the name Bluto is taken

parts.note: to experience something is to live through it

explanation.surface: Bluto, Popeye's rival in the cartoons, has a final experience with Popeye's companion.
explanation.walkthrough: Popeye's girlfriend in the cartoons is Olive Oyl; Bluto is the bully who competes for her.
explanation.definitionFit: The sailor Popeye's sweetheart in the comic strip and cartoons is named Olive Oyl.

clue.text: Capital governed after tense case with explosive

indicators.note: after places the word for governed behind the other pieces
a case is the outer shell, so only the outside letters of the word tense are used

parts.note: HE is short for high explosive
to run a country is to govern it

explanation.surface: A capital city ruled by force after a tense standoff over explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: Teheran, an older spelling of Tehran, is the capital city of Iran.

clue.text: Over with silly point always at the centre

indicators.note: over signals turning the word for silly the other way round

parts.note: dim means stupid or silly
W, west, is a compass point
ay is an old poetic word for always

explanation.surface: A cricket over bowled with a fielder at silly point, always in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: The cricket words (over, silly point) are a false trail; silly point is a close fielding position.
explanation.definitionFit: Something halfway between two ends lies in the middle, at the centre of the span.

clue.text: Shrank from verbal warning by our boss?

indicators.note: verbal means spoken, so the word is judged by how it is pronounced

parts.note: to be lessoned is to be taught a lesson or admonished, as by a boss

explanation.surface: Someone shrank back after a spoken warning from the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrank and its synonym both mean became smaller or reduced in amount.

clue.text: Extremely large hostelry used to open functions

parts.note: too means excessively or extremely
L is the clothing size abbreviation for large
a bar is a drinking place, a hostelry

explanation.surface: An enormous pub hired for opening parties and functions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Functions' suggests parties at the pub; it means software commands.
explanation.definitionFit: In software, a strip of icons at the top of a window lets the user launch commands.

clue.text: Drug that helps to stay fit!

definitions.text: Drug that helps to stay fit!

parts.words: Drug that helps to stay fit!
parts.note: fit here is a convulsion or spasm, and to stay it is to stop it, not to keep healthy

explanation.definitionFit: Such a medicine relieves involuntary muscle contractions, stopping a seizure or fit.

clue.text: Work very energetically initially in short time

indicators.note: in places the opening letters inside the word for a short time

parts.note: a moment is a brief span of time

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the words very and energetically

explanation.surface: Someone works flat out for a brief spell.
explanation.definitionFit: A movement is a section of a symphony or other musical work.

clue.text: Score from outside right's headers, helping outside box

indicators.note: headers are the tops, so the first letters of outside and right's are taken

parts.note: a chest is a box
a ration is a portion or helping; outside just places it beyond the box

explanation.surface: A football report: a goal from the outside right's header, assisting from outside the box.
explanation.walkthrough: The football picture misleads: outside right, headers and box all play non-football roles here, and 'Score' is musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging music for an orchestra produces the full score of the piece.

clue.text: Sound of horse's refusal?

parts.note: a horse's call is pronounced like nay, the old word for no, so its noise sounds like a refusal

explanation.definitionFit: A horse's whinny is pronounced just like 'nay', an archaic word for no.

clue.text: Setter almost glowed in severe shame

indicators.note: in puts the setter and the shortened word inside the word for severe

parts.note: dour means stern or severe
the setter refers to themselves as I

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: shone means glowed

explanation.surface: The setter, nearly glowing with embarrassment, is in deep shame.
explanation.definitionFit: Disgrace and loss of honour amount to shame; the noun is a synonym.

clue.text: Ordering beer in at around one, getting drunk

indicators.note: around puts the shuffled letters about the numeral for one
ordering means arranging, so the letters of beer, in and at are rearranged

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone orders beer at about one o'clock and ends up drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordering' gives a mix of nine letters less I, and 'getting drunk' tempts as a verb phrase, but 'drunk' alone is the noun definition.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun this is a habitual drunkard, someone intoxicated, a drunk.

clue.text: Carpenter perhaps, by chestnut tree

parts.note: the carpenter bee is one kind of bee, so this is an example
CH is an abbreviation for chestnut, the horse colour

explanation.surface: A carpenter working by a chestnut tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpenter' suggests a woodworker; it is the carpenter bee.
explanation.definitionFit: The beech is a common deciduous broadleaf tree with smooth grey bark.

clue.text: Sitting in against losing work

indicators.note: losing means the word for work is taken out

parts.note: opposing means against
op is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Taking part in a sit-in against job losses.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting for a portrait or photographer means holding a pose for them.

clue.text: Careless keystroke holding BlackBerry?

indicators.note: holding means the stroke encloses the device abbreviation

parts.note: a slash is a stroke character typed on a keyboard
a BlackBerry is an example of a PDA, a personal digital assistant

explanation.surface: A careless keystroke made on a BlackBerry phone.
explanation.definitionFit: Slapdash work is done hastily and sloppily, without proper care.

clue.text: House of Commons is second to none

definitions.meaning: the Commons is the house without any lords, a chamber with no members of the peerage

explanation.surface: The House of Commons is the best there is.
explanation.definitionFit: Peers are lords and also equals; the Commons lacks lords, and the best thing has no equal.

clue.text: Burns writes about first character of mouse

indicators.note: about means the word for writes surrounds the letter

parts.note: to create is to produce or write

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word mouse is taken

explanation.surface: Robert Burns writes about a mouse, as in his poem To a Mouse.
explanation.walkthrough: Burns looks like the Scottish poet; it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Cremating a body means burning it to ashes, so the verbs match.

clue.text: With small talk, Sun slings mud

parts.note: patter is glib talk
S is the abbreviation for Sun, as in Sunday

explanation.surface: The Sun tabloid, with its gossip, smears people.
explanation.definitionFit: To spatter is to splash or besmirch, here figuratively hurling mud at someone's reputation.

clue.text: Twister's in stir following bust

indicators.note: following puts the word for stir after the word for bust

parts.note: bust means broken, torn
ado is fuss or a stir

explanation.surface: A twister lands in prison after a police raid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twister' suggests a cheat sent to stir (prison) after a bust; it is the whirlwind.
explanation.definitionFit: A twister is an informal word for a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: Right looking for support in the House

parts.note: to be after something is to seek it

explanation.surface: A right-winger seeking support in the House of Commons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'House' suggests Parliament; it is a building's roof.
explanation.definitionFit: A roof beam holds up the roof of a building such as a house.

clue.text: Variant found in DNA, not hereditary

indicators.note: found in means the letters lie within the run of words DNA, not hereditary

explanation.surface: A genetic variant found in DNA that is not inherited.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant is a different version of something, a different one of the same kind.

clue.text: About a rose, sort of rose

parts.note: re means about or concerning
rose is a pinkish red colour

explanation.surface: Gardeners talking about a rose and its variety.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'rose' gives RED; 'sort of rose' is the definition, as a horse rears up.
explanation.definitionFit: To rear is to rise up on the hind legs, so this is one particular way of rising.

clue.text: Harmony from second half of disc by Queen

indicators.note: the second half of the word for disc is kept, the first half removed

parts.note: a record is a disc
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Harmony on the second half of a Queen record.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen looks like the rock band; ER is the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Order is a state of peace and harmonious arrangement.

clue.text: One remembers moments in recollection

indicators.note: read as re-collection, the letters are gathered again in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A person recalls special moments in memory.
explanation.definitionFit: A memory expert trained in techniques for recall is someone who remembers things.

clue.text: Japan missing top winning score in judo

indicators.note: missing top means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: Nippon is the Japanese name for Japan

explanation.surface: Japan failing to top the judo scoring.
explanation.definitionFit: In judo the full point that ends a bout outright is called this.

clue.text: Right away socialist leader Brown's in between

indicators.note: in places the leader and colour inside the word for between

parts.note: inter is the Latin word for between

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of the word socialist

parts.note: tan is a light brown colour

explanation.surface: A socialist leader called Brown is caught in between.
explanation.walkthrough: Brown suggests the Labour leader Gordon Brown; it is a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: This old-fashioned adverb means immediately, at once, without any delay.

clue.text: Animal in river

parts.note: the Greek name of this beast means river horse, and it wallows in African rivers

explanation.definitionFit: This large African mammal spends its days in rivers; its Greek name means river horse.

clue.text: In view of bank taken by criminal gang

indicators.note: taken by means the word for bank is held inside the other pieces

parts.note: con is short for convict, a criminal
a ring is a criminal gang
a side, as of a river, is a bank

explanation.surface: A bank job carried out by a criminal gang.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' suggests a robbery; it is a riverbank.
explanation.definitionFit: As a preposition it means taking into account, in light of.
